questions.question: Why was the east gate of the sanctuary to remain shut, in Ezekiel 44?
options: Because it led directly to the inner chambers of the priests
Because the great enemy might come and attack from that side
Because only the high priest alone was permitted to use it
Because the LORD, the God of Israel, had entered by it
questions.answer: Because the LORD, the God of Israel, had entered by it

questions.question: Which priests are given charge of the sanctuary in Ezekiel 44?
options: The sons of Aaron, the first high priest
The Levites who carried the ark
The elders chosen from all the tribes
The sons of Zadok, who were faithful
questions.answer: The sons of Zadok, who were faithful

questions.question: Ezekiel 44 forbids the uncircumcised in heart and flesh from entering the sanctuary.
This gate shall remain _____, because the LORD has entered by it.
The Levitical priests, the sons of _____, who kept charge of my sanctuary, shall come near to me.
